display_name: 源域微弱变化的可观察性与恢复响应
description: 复用 224 条源 IQ 的已冻结响应，按同条模拟 Action 和标量噪声强度预设分箱，检查响应偏差与可观察性代理。
authorization: Existing L_s/U_s source-only diagnostic permission; no OE, V, TX truth or target input.

code.environment: N607 CPU only, CPU threads2, CUDA disabled, original FP64 action and scalar noise proxy.

data.version: Original R07 draw01 224 fixed source records:35 L_s,189 U_s; seven scenes,32 records each.
data.representation: Original source simulated Action/noise and already frozen four-direction IQ/F0 response statistics.
data.physical_ids_ref: Existing response reference.npz source indices and physical IDs checked against every saved scene.
data.label_map_ref: Unused for scoring. Original F0 default head used only in no-query smoke; continuous source features in numerical objectives.
data.validation_ref: Original R07 source cache and source response diagnostic fixed before this calculation.
data.support_query_ref: No V/OE/novel/target inputs, no source TX labels.
data.actual_training_labels: No optimization or TX labels. CPU calculation reuses source simulation Action/noise and saved model response statistics.
data.augmentation: Existing fixed 1%-RMS perturbations; no new synthesis.

permissions.query_use: 224 pre-existing L_s/U_s source rows and their saved IQ/F0 response statistics only. No target, V/OE/novel, TX truth or model forward.
permissions.claim_scope: Synthetic-direction scalar-white-noise proxy and observed fixed G/F0 response association, not identity preservation, deployable source-action access, causal gain or theory bound.

checkpoint.initialization: None: no models loaded, no forward or optimizer.
sources: 20261107-diagnostic-Restore-CovarianceResponse-sourceLU-s2026092701-r01/4f1551ce4d81f4f3d1cade52bebaaeabe1b7316e fixed source responses and original R07 source draw01 simulator trace.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original source diagnostic status/source-only fields, ID/scene alignment, original cache contract and actual two-row matrix smoke.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source L_s/U_s only; saved fixed responses are derived from previously frozen source-only models. No target or V/OE reads.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All fixed 7 scenes × 4 directions × 3 models, predefined proxy bins [0,1),[1,9),[9,25),[25,∞); no model selection.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, two CPU threads; no GPU process.
execution.stop_rule: Source provenance or ID/scene alignment mismatch, nonfinite Action/variance/statistics, failed two-row analytic smoke or process error: preserve and stop; no target or model fallback.

metric_names: Proxy ||A_true delta||² / scalar noise variance; fixed bins 0,1,9,25; sample counts and energy-weighted IQ/F0 projection and response error.
Seven scenes and all-source pooled, four synthetic directions and three previously frozen models. Scenes have distinct records.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: No TX truth or independent identity scoring; separate arithmetic check against archived response vectors.

rows.purpose: Test whether weak source perturbations fall in low action-to-noise regimes and whether fixed response errors vary across those bins.
rows.seed_notes: Exact previously fixed original draw01,224 source records and four 1% directions.
rows.scenario: Source L_s/U_s seven simulation scenes only, no target.
rows.budget_ref: 224 source rows × four fixed directions; source simulator traces and prior response statistics only; zero neural/optimizer calls.

notes: All bin thresholds fixed before this calculation; the threshold9 follows the earlier source scalar-noise Fisher proxy, not target tuning.
Recorded true simulator Action and scalar variance are used only for source diagnosis; variance is a model proxy and source counterfactuals reuse the same noise.
Small fixed source samples and distinct source records per scene do not establish a causal effect, TX authenticity or information limit.
Two focused tests passed; independent P0/P1 identified Torch/NumPy bridge incompatibility, fixed and targeted re-review passed. First two source rows are an actual matrix smoke.
